nodes.label: Local workspace server
nodes.summary: 127.0.0.1 HTTP + SSE per shared session (stable port/token); token, Origin and tailnet+paired-cookie checks; chat, activity, dialog, status, model/effort, files, diagram edit and Generate endpoints.
nodes.details: Serves browser .ts assets after stripTypeScriptTypes; command dispatch and Stop via ctx.abort. Authenticated image-paste endpoint validates image bytes and writes a temporary file; revision-checked note/move endpoints and HTTP/SSE snapshots synchronize the browser.

nodes.label: Workspace browser app
nodes.summary: Rough.js diagram with Project/Plan tabs and a desktop editing bar, chat with status line (model/effort/plan menus), Files tab, mobile tabs, prompts and the shared-session switcher.
nodes.details: Grid-packed groups with orthogonal edge routing and calm bundled connections; semantic zoom, tinted cards, Ctrl+F search. Drag a box to move it (persisted), drag empty canvas to pan. The editing bar adds boxes/groups, connects, deletes, renames, recolors and resizes as red pending edits; each adds a chat line tied to its diagram, and undoing an unsent add drops its lines. Generate asks for remembered directions. Collapsed thinking/tool chat blocks, auto-follow with jump-to-bottom, image paste to a temporary file path, and right-click note composition. Browser commands and question dialogs share the live terminal session.
